description: This file defines the feature gate system for Kubernetes, including feature specifications, dependency management, versioning, and flag parsing for enabling/disabling features based on version and stability levels.

classes.name: FeatureSpec
classes.description: Defines the specifications for a feature, including default state, stability level, version, and compatibility constraints.

classes.name: VersionedSpecs
classes.description: A slice of FeatureSpec representing different versions of a feature.

classes.name: featureGate
classes.description: Implements the FeatureGate interface, manages feature states, dependencies, versioning, and flag parsing.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of feature key-value pairs and sets feature gates accordingly.

methods.name: SetWithLogger
methods.description: Same as Set, but with a specified logger for logging.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates current feature gate settings against feature specifications and version constraints.

methods.name: unsafeSetFromMap
methods.description: Sets feature gates from a map of string keys to bool values, validating against known features and version constraints.

methods.name: SetFromMap
methods.description: Sets feature gates from a map of string keys to bool values.

methods.name: SetFromMapWithLogger
methods.description: Same as SetFromMap, but with a specified logger.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of enabled features in key=value format.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name for flag parsing.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds features with default specifications to the feature gate.

methods.name: AddVersioned
methods.description: Adds versioned feature specifications to the feature gate.

methods.name: AddDependencies
methods.description: Adds feature dependencies, validating for cycles and constraints.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns a copy of the feature dependencies map.

methods.name: OverrideDefault
methods.description: Overrides the default value of a feature.

methods.name: OverrideDefaultWithLogger
methods.description: Overrides the default value of a feature with logging.

methods.name: OverrideDefaultAtVersion
methods.description: Overrides the default value of a feature at a specific version.

methods.name: OverrideDefaultAtVersionWithLogger
methods.description: Same as OverrideDefaultAtVersion, with logging.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all features with their current effective specifications.

methods.name: GetAllVersioned
methods.description: Returns all features with their versioned specifications.

methods.name: SetEmulationVersion
methods.description: Sets the emulation version for feature gating.

methods.name: SetEmulationVersionWithLogger
methods.description: Sets the emulation version with logging.

methods.name: SetEmulationVersionAndMinCompatibilityVersion
methods.description: Sets emulation and minimum compatibility versions.

methods.name: SetEmulationVersionAndMinCompatibilityVersionWithLogger
methods.description: Sets emulation and min compatibility versions with logging.

methods.name: EmulationVersion
methods.description: Returns the current emulation version.

methods.name: MinCompatibilityVersion
methods.description: Returns the current minimum compatibility version.

methods.name: featureSpec
methods.description: Retrieves the feature specification at the current emulation and min compatibility versions.

methods.name: featureSpecAtEmulationAndMinCompatVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the feature specification at specified emulation and min compatibility versions.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Prevents further addition of features to the feature gate.

methods.name: AddFlag
methods.description: Adds a command-line flag for setting feature gates.

methods.name: AddMetrics
methods.description: Records metrics for feature enablement.

methods.name: KnownFeatures
methods.description: Returns a list of known feature names and their default states.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the feature gate.

methods.name: DeepCopyAndReset
methods.description: Creates a copy of the feature gate with reset feature states.

methods.name: ExplicitlySet
methods.description: Checks if a feature's value was explicitly set.

methods.name: ResetFeatureValueToDefault
methods.description: Resets a feature's value to its default.

methods.name: featureEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a feature is enabled based on current settings and version constraints.

methods.name: featureSpec
methods.description: Returns the feature specification for a given feature key.
